name: Events Route - The Calendar With No Past Events Yet
description: The /events page for an organisation whose history has not started yet: everything in the collection is still ahead of today. The page opens with its OWN title and standfirst, then the live Luma calendar - and then stops. No Past Events grid, no link out to Luma's archive, no folded year rows, because there is nothing behind us to show. It is the counterpart to the upcoming-and-past scenario beside it and the state a brand-new chapter is actually in, which is the case most likely to be left unhandled: the page still has to read as finished rather than truncated. The title above the calendar is the change this frame carries - the page used to open on the embed's own heading, Full events calendar, so a visitor's first line of text belonged to a third party rather than to the site. NOTE ON THE FRAME: the resting capture shows the title, the standfirst and the calendar - the same top-of-page as the upcoming-and-past scenario beside it, because everything that differs sits below the fold. The difference is real and is in the markup, not the picture: this page renders two headings, that one renders four, adding Past Events and Archive 2013-2019. It could not be framed lower - a hover on the foot times out because the Luma iframe above keeps resizing, and the only clickable element down there navigates away. The isolated eventspage-no-events scenario shows this same state without the embed dominating the frame.
